g.text: · one ticket per confirmed session, not per registration
· VOID: cannot be transferred or checked in
· USED: cannot be transferred or checked in again
· a TRANSFERRED ticket can be transferred again
· voidTicket() is a no-op on VOID or USED
Enforces two of the three rules in specs/3 §5.4:
void tickets and duplicate check-ins. The third,
"outside the session window", needs programme data
this context does not hold (see specs/2 FR-13).
+issue(id, TicketCode, registrationId, sessionId, attendeeId, Holder) : Ticket
Value objects are Java records, mapped as JPA
entities inside the Ticket aggregate (cascade ALL,
gate wait that FR-16 will aggregate.
